from scipy import stats
import json

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# 2. remove exact duplicates, keep first

# 3. replace -999 sentinel with NaN across all columns
df = df.replace(-999, np.nan)

# 4. filter age 18-80 inclusive
df = df[(df['age'] >= 18) & (df['age'] <= 80)]

# 5. normalise treatment
df['treatment_norm'] = df['treatment'].str.strip().str.lower()

# 6. drop rows with missing biomass

unfert = df[df['treatment_norm'] == 'unfertilised']['biomass']

med_unfert = unfert.median()
median_diff = med_fert - med_unfert

res = stats.mannwhitneyu(fert, unfert, alternative='two-sided', use_continuity=True, method='asymptotic')

out = {
 'n_unfertilised': n_unfert,
 'n_fertilised': n_fert,
 'median_unfertilised': med_unfert,
 'median_fertilised': med_fert,
 'median_diff': median_diff,
 'u_stat': U,
 'p_value': p,
 'rank_biserial': rank_biserial
}
print(json.dumps(out))
